# Bayes FC

> Football power rankings from the betting market: daily attack, defence, and overall strength ratings for Europe's top football clubs, derived from closing betting-market prices and rebuilt every day.

Bayes FC publishes market-based football power rankings for 7 European leagues: every club on one cross-league scale, plus a table per league, updated daily.

## Ratings

- [Global cross-league ladder](https://bayesfc.com/): Market-based football power rankings: every European club on one comparable strength scale, rebuilt daily from betting-market closing prices.
- [League ladders](https://bayesfc.com/leagues.html): Football power rankings for each of Europe's top leagues: daily attack, defence and overall strength ratings for every club, derived from closing betting-market prices.
- [Club pages](https://bayesfc.com/club/): one page per rated club — its rating over time, recent results, upcoming fixtures and season projection (132 clubs).

## Questions

- [Who is the strongest team in Europe?](https://bayesfc.com/strongest-team-in-europe/): As of 16 October 2026, the market rates Arsenal the strongest club in Europe, ahead of Bayern Munich and Manchester City.
- [Which is the strongest league in Europe?](https://bayesfc.com/strongest-league-in-europe/): As of 16 October 2026, the Premier League is the strongest league in Europe by the average rating of its clubs, ahead of La Liga and the Bundesliga.
- [Which league has the most open title race?](https://bayesfc.com/most-open-title-race/): As of 16 October 2026, Serie A has the most open title race, with 3.2 effective contenders, ahead of the Eredivisie (3.1) and the Primeira Liga (2.7).
- [Who will win the Premier League this season?](https://bayesfc.com/premier-league/title-race/): As of 16 October 2026, the Premier League title race has 2.2 effective contenders, down 0.2 this week. Manchester City is the most likely Premier League champion at 56%, ahead of Arsenal (42%) and Liverpool (1%).
- [Who is the strongest team in the Premier League?](https://bayesfc.com/premier-league/strongest-team/): As of 16 October 2026, the market rates Arsenal the strongest side in the Premier League, ahead of Manchester City and Liverpool.
- [Who will be relegated from the Premier League this season?](https://bayesfc.com/premier-league/relegation/): As of 16 October 2026, the Premier League relegation race has 8.3 effective clubs in danger, up 0.2 this week. Hull is the most likely to be relegated from the Premier League at 77%, ahead of Coventry (65%) and Ipswich (38%).
- [Who will win La Liga this season?](https://bayesfc.com/la-liga/title-race/): As of 16 October 2026, the La Liga title race has 1.6 effective contenders, unchanged this week. Barcelona is the most likely La Liga champion at 84%, ahead of Real Madrid (15%) and Atletico Madrid (1%).
- [Who is the strongest team in La Liga?](https://bayesfc.com/la-liga/strongest-team/): As of 16 October 2026, the market rates Barcelona the strongest side in La Liga, ahead of Real Madrid and Atletico Madrid.
- [Who will be relegated from La Liga this season?](https://bayesfc.com/la-liga/relegation/): As of 16 October 2026, the La Liga relegation race has 9.5 effective clubs in danger, down 0.1 this week. Malaga is the most likely to be relegated from La Liga at 69%, ahead of Elche (45%) and Santander (32%).
- [Who will win Serie A this season?](https://bayesfc.com/serie-a/title-race/): As of 16 October 2026, the Serie A title race has 3.2 effective contenders, down 0.2 this week. Inter is the most likely Serie A champion at 65%, ahead of Roma (15%) and Juventus (9%).
- [Who is the strongest team in Serie A?](https://bayesfc.com/serie-a/strongest-team/): As of 16 October 2026, the market rates Inter the strongest side in Serie A, ahead of Juventus and Roma.
- [Who will be relegated from Serie A this season?](https://bayesfc.com/serie-a/relegation/): As of 16 October 2026, the Serie A relegation race has 7.8 effective clubs in danger, down 0.4 this week. Parma is the most likely to be relegated from Serie A at 69%, ahead of Lecce (52%) and Monza (51%).
- [Who will win the Bundesliga this season?](https://bayesfc.com/bundesliga/title-race/): As of 16 October 2026, the Bundesliga title race has 1.2 effective contenders, unchanged this week. Bayern Munich is the most likely Bundesliga champion at 97%, ahead of Dortmund (2%) and Leverkusen (–).
- [Who is the strongest team in the Bundesliga?](https://bayesfc.com/bundesliga/strongest-team/): As of 16 October 2026, the market rates Bayern Munich the strongest side in the Bundesliga, ahead of Dortmund and Leverkusen.
- [Who will be relegated from the Bundesliga this season?](https://bayesfc.com/bundesliga/relegation/): As of 16 October 2026, the Bundesliga relegation race has 7.8 effective clubs in danger, down 0.1 this week. Paderborn is the most likely to be relegated from the Bundesliga at 48%, ahead of Union Berlin (40%) and M'gladbach (36%).
- [Who will win Ligue 1 this season?](https://bayesfc.com/ligue-1/title-race/): As of 16 October 2026, the Ligue 1 title race has 1.3 effective contenders, up 0.1 this week. Paris SG is the most likely Ligue 1 champion at 94%, ahead of Monaco (3%) and Lille (1%).
- [Who is the strongest team in Ligue 1?](https://bayesfc.com/ligue-1/strongest-team/): As of 16 October 2026, the market rates Paris SG the strongest side in Ligue 1, ahead of Monaco and Lens.
- [Who will be relegated from Ligue 1 this season?](https://bayesfc.com/ligue-1/relegation/): As of 16 October 2026, the Ligue 1 relegation race has 6.9 effective clubs in danger, down 0.4 this week. Le Havre is the most likely to be relegated from Ligue 1 at 51%, ahead of Troyes (42%) and Le Mans (30%).
- [Who will win the Primeira Liga this season?](https://bayesfc.com/primeira-liga/title-race/): As of 16 October 2026, the Primeira Liga title race has 2.7 effective contenders, unchanged this week. Benfica is the most likely Primeira Liga champion at 47%, ahead of Porto (39%) and Sp Lisbon (14%).
- [Who is the strongest team in the Primeira Liga?](https://bayesfc.com/primeira-liga/strongest-team/): As of 16 October 2026, the market rates Benfica the strongest side in the Primeira Liga, ahead of Porto and Sp Lisbon.

- [Who will win the Eredivisie this season?](https://bayesfc.com/eredivisie/title-race/): As of 16 October 2026, the Eredivisie title race has 3.1 effective contenders, down 0.2 this week. PSV Eindhoven is the most likely Eredivisie champion at 57%, ahead of Feyenoord (27%) and Twente (7%).

## Writing

- [Who got the easy start? First five games in England, Spain and Germany](https://bayesfc.com/blog/fixture-difficulty-opening-five.html): Every club's first five league games in the Premier League, La Liga and the Bundesliga, ranked from the hardest opening to the easiest.
- [What a wage bill buys](https://bayesfc.com/blog/what-a-wage-bill-buys.html): Across Europe's top seven leagues, pay explains most of team strength — but the clubs off the line are the interesting ones.
- [How we turn betting odds into team strength](https://bayesfc.com/blog/how-we-turn-betting-odds-into-team-strength.html): Why betting odds tell you more about a team than results or xG — and how we read team strength straight out of them.
